activity.notes: ATLAS uses c.440-c.360 BCE as an explicitly approximate representative medical-activity window for the historical Hippocrates of Kos. The range preserves the uncertainty surrounding his personal chronology and the authorship of the Hippocratic Corpus; it is not asserted as an exact career span.

sources.title: Hippocrates: The Forefather of Neurology — PMC
sources.citation_text: The reviewed medical-history article treats Hippocrates as the historical physician of Kos and discusses an approximate fifth-to-fourth-century BCE chronology while distinguishing him from the broader Hippocratic corpus.
